About Us

ABOUT ELITE PROPERTY MAINTENANCE
YOUR PROPERTY CARE EXPERTS

At Elite Property Maintenance, we are dedicated to providing professional, reliable, and affordable property maintenance solutions for commercial and residential properties throughout Central Michigan.

As a proud veteran-owned and operated business, we hold ourselves to higher standards. From routine weekly lawn mowing and crisp perimeter edging to winter snow plowing, car hauling, and emergency storm clearing, we make sure your property always looks its absolute best.

  • ✓
    Professional property care for both homes and businesses
  • ✓
    Expert mowing, trimming, and precision edging
  • ✓
    Reliable snow plowing for driveways, parking lots, and sidewalks
  • ✓
    Fast debris, brush, junk car hauling & emergency storm damage response
  • 🎖️
    Veterans & Seniors Discount: 20% off for qualifying veterans and seniors

How It Works

STEP-BY-STEP SERVICE
WITH ELITE PROPERTY MAINTENANCE

Our process is designed to keep your property healthy, clean, and beautifully maintained with minimal effort on your part.

START YOUR SERVICE→
STEP 01

REQUEST A FREE ESTIMATE

Simply contact us to share the details of your lawn or property and request a free estimate. We provide upfront, transparent pricing.

STEP 02

SCHEDULE YOUR SERVICE

Choose a convenient date and time for our veteran-owned professional team to visit your property. We show up on time and ready to work.

STEP 03

ENJOY A BEAUTIFUL PROPERTY

We perform expert lawn care, snow plowing, hauling, and cleanups, leaving your property pristine from your lawn to your driveway.
